plan.notes:
Source: official 2023-2024 Ouachita Residential Catalog, 'Suggested Course Sequence for the Double Major of B.A. in International Missions and B.S.N.' (catalog p.68-69). OBU-R = Ouachita Residential, OBU-O = Ouachita Online, BHCLR = Baptist Health College Little Rock (dual enrollment). BHCLR clinical-block credits are not printed per-course in the catalog; credits shown are from OBU's official curriculum summary (obu.edu/committees/docs/Curriculum_Change_Summary_May_2018.pdf): NSG 1010=10, NSG 2107=7, NSG 2207=7, NSG 1002=2, Pharmacology II=1, Pharmacology III=1, NSG 2004/2104/2204=4; these sum to the printed term totals exactly (14/17/15). Genuine catalog anomalies preserved: the sequence prints 'NSG 2004 Pharmacology II' and 'NSG 2201 Pharmacology III' while OBU's official summary lists those BHCLR courses as NSG 2101 and NSG 2401; two distinct courses are both numbered NSG 2004 in Year 4 Semester 2 (Women's Health and Pharmacology II). 'Chapel' is listed each term with no credit hours; catalog requires a chapel credit per full-time semester (catalog p.30/51) so it is seeded required_zero=true. FINA 4011 Arts Engagement Series = 1 cr per the catalog's CORE summary (p.51). total_credits = 158 (sequenced sum).

allow_repeated_courses: 'Chapel' (CHAP 1000, 0 cr, required_zero=true) is required each full-time semester per the official OBU 2023-2024 Residential Catalog (p.30/51; 'CHAP 1000 Chapel (7 credits required)' graduation requirement — '7 Chapel Credits, or 1 per semester for transfer students'); seeded each term exactly as printed.

2026-10-01: 'NSG 2004 Pharmacology II (BHCLR)' corrected to NSG 2101 per OBU's official curriculum summary (see course note); the catalog's 'NSG 2201 Pharmacology III' (single instance, no duplicate) is preserved as printed.
